criteria.requirement: Add pyrsistent.merge.deep_merge(left,right,conflict="replace",max_depth=32) and MergeConflict.path. left is a PMap and right accepts mapping or pairs through the earlier delivered update capability. Merge mapping/mapping branches recursively, leaf conflicts replace by default, raise with full tuple path or call an explicit (path,old,new) resolver. Equal/unmodified values share existing branches; new builtin containers are frozen with strict=False to preserve already-persistent checked types. Use actual evolvers, preserve CheckedPMap validation, reject unsupported policy/depth and surface type/source/callback failures without changing left. Do not claim automatic concatenation of sequences, arbitrary object deepcopy or a concurrent transaction. Cyclic/unrepresentable new builtin containers fail explicitly.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
